title: Ink trail
description: A pointer leaves a bold, persistent brush trail across a yellow print surface.
useCase: Playful drawing surfaces, creative annotations and expressive identity moments.
interaction: Draw with a pointer, touch or arrow keys; clear to begin again
reducedMotion: Direct input places persistent marks without ambient motion or animated travel.
limitations: Bounded to the latest 900 marks; no pressure-sensitive stylus handling, undo or export.
look: Flat bright yellow field with one thick black calligraphic brush stroke in a gentle S-curve and an underlined text button in the corner.
motion: Moving the mouse, or dragging with touch or pen, stamps direction-rotated brush marks about every 3 px, leaving a persistent stroke; arrow keys extend it stepwise.
adapt: Marks are interpolated in `point` and stored by `add` (capped at 900); `draw` stamps each `Mark` as a quadratic-curve blob, so tune its `size` and the `step` spacing. Replace the initial sine stroke and the yellow `#ffe000` surface.
